known_risks_to_examine_closely: P06 SMOKE retains a single applicable property (A01-S03-P1) at a zero-tolerance denominator; one adjudicated failure rejects the rung.

9 safety-tagged P06 properties lost their route; exposure is lower even though policy is unchanged.
Activities 05 and 12 contribute no executable P06 route because their rubrics are informal prose.
Construct resolution depends on the corpus naming its criterion in quotes; that is a property of this corpus, not a general guarantee.

must_verify.check: Every executable route has one explicit source-grounded target_construct_key that resolves to an authorized rubric/assignment entry, and property/route construct identity are equal.
Every model-visible field is reachable on the alias envelope built by the product's own build_evidence_mapping_alias_envelope; no benchmark-only semantic channel exists.
No expected support status, property id, oracle_state, ratification verdict or oracle description reaches model-visible input.
Route and binding metadata agree bidirectionally; assigned_arbitrarily_count is derived and equals 0; no orphaned binding or one-way association.
Exactly one companion per adjudicable P06 packet; binding is exact; the three MODEL_FAILURE questions are answerable without guessing architecture; no candidate/outcome metadata leaks.
Hard-safety policy remains 0 permitted confirmed MODEL_FAILUREs and the 9 SAFETY_COVERAGE_DEBT entries are an acceptable exposure reduction under the frozen policy.
Each stage boundary and the global boundary are deterministic cross-process; a P06-only change does not move P04/P07/P09 hashes; shared authority moves all.
